User-defined Functions:

Positive:
•  Good use of the following:
      - docstring - providing context; stating what the function does
      - docstring - clearly defining all input variables/objects
      - docstring - clearly defining the returned object(s)
      - internal check - proper use of 'if not isinstance', 'raise' statements, etc.
      - isolating ideas to user-defined functions
      - type hinting - applied well for input variables (and for what is returned, if applicable)

Neutral:
•  Okay user-defined function(s), but the following could be improved:
      - complex - a bit too many ideas placed into a single function

Negative:
•  Your user-defined functions had the following problems:
      - complex - too many ideas place in a single function, which limits reusability, transferability and debugging
      - global variables - use local variable in your function (e.g., improves transferability)
      - structure - main code logic should be nested under the internal checks (e.g., within an else statement) for clear flow control
      - types redundancy - type hinting is enough, no need to also specify the types again in the docstring
